name: cluster_forms
expr: v1 = sum(pdist(X)); v2 = sum(pdist(X, 'cityblock')); v3 = pdist(X, 'minkowski', 3); v3 = v3(1); v4 = pdist(X, 'mahalanobis'); v4 = v4(1); v5 = numel(pdist(ones(1,2))); v6 = double(strcmp(class(pdist(single(X))), 'single')); D8 = pdist2(X, X(1:2,:)); v7 = sum(D8(:)); v8 = mahal(X(2:5,:), X); v8 = v8(1); Z1 = linkage(Yp); v9 = Z1(1,1); v10 = Z1(1,3); v11 = Z1(4,3); Z2 = linkage(X, 'complete'); v12 = Z2(3,3); Z3 = linkage(X, 'single', 'cityblock'); v13 = Z3(4,3); I5 = inconsistent(Z1); v14 = I5(1,1); v15 = I5(4,1); I6 = inconsistent(Z1, 3); v16 = I6(4,1); c7 = cluster(Z1, 'maxclust', 2); u7 = unique(c7); n7 = histcounts(c7, [0.5 1.5 2.5]); v17 = numel(u7); v18 = max(n7) - min(n7); c8 = cluster(Z1, 'cutoff', 0.5); n8 = histcounts(c8, [0.5 1.5 2.5]); v19 = max(n8) - min(n8); s10 = silhouette(X, [1 1 2 2 2]); v20 = s10(1); v21 = s10(3); v22 = s10(5);
comment: Clustering-family argcheck-drain spec 2026-09-19 (probe77 + full-precision recheck): pdist metric values (cityblock/minkowski-3/mahalanobis), the 1x0 single-row empty, single contagion; pdist2 cross-distance sums; mahal values; linkage on the condensed vector and on raw data with method+metric; inconsistent depth forms; cluster maxclust/cutoff asserted structurally (labels are arbitrary between engines - partition sizes, not labels); silhouette values. pdist2 'Smallest'/'Largest' is an nk extension the reference REMOVED (probed P09) - covered by the gtest only.
